[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 390
- Description: Agroverse brand film v9 — motion picture generation, scoring, publishing & media-lineage system
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/generated-media-raw/pull/1
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/generated-media-raw/pull/2
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1827
  
  Details:
  Built, scored, published and audited the Agroverse brand film (V7 → V9), plus the archive lineage system that prevents raw-clip reuse across future films.
  
  DELIVERABLES
  
  1. Picture — V9 brand film (12.542 s, 1280×720, 24 fps, 301 frames)
  - Endcard A7 then A8: rendered at 2x and LANCZOS-downscaled for crisp type; background pixel-verified #ffffff at every corner probe to match the --color-bg token (the cream in V6 was an invention, corrected).
  - Mission line promoted to primary on the endcard: "Restoring 10,000 hectares of Amazon rainforest", tagline subordinate. Sourced verbatim from PURPOSE_AND_MISSION.md.
  - Picture is bit-identical to V7 through the music mux (-c:v copy), so adding audio introduced zero generation loss.
  - Full 9-frame arc QC via Gemini vision — PASS, quality_problems: []; endcard text was TRANSCRIBED by the model (not just approved), returning both lines verbatim, confirming legibility and no clipping.
  
  2. Music — original composition (bed A, kalimba-forward)
  - Rejected the CC-licence route after searching Archive.org (19,042 ambient/cinematic hits): audio cannot be judged by measurement, so a random track would have been a gamble with the brand. Composed the bed instead — DAO-owned, zero rights/Content ID risk, survives retailer reposting.
  - Written to the cut's exact length (12.542 s), harmonic arc Dmaj9 → Bm9 → Gmaj9 → Asus (unresolved), landing on an open, hopeful endcard. Fades 0.45 s in / 1.5 s out.
  - Delivered at -14.7 LUFS integrated, peak -5.3 dBFS (broadcast-appropriate). Measured with ebur128 after a first loudness grep returned empty — re-measured rather than quoting numbers not actually seen.
  - Two beds produced (A kalimba / B pad) so the governor could choose by ear.
  
  3. Publishing — YouTube, public, properly indexed
  - Published [GENERATED] Agroverse — Restoring 10,000 Hectares of Amazon Rainforest (Brand Film v9) → https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vlZLzXQpIOs
  - Public visibility independently PROVEN, not inferred from the uploader's success line: privacyStatus public, uploadStatus processed, definition hd, embeddable true, anonymous watch page HTTP 200 and anonymous oEmbed returning title/author.
  
  4. Indexing audit — public is not the same as findable
  Found and fixed four measured gaps on the live upload: 0 caption tracks → 1 en descriptive track; no hashtags → 10; no playlist → new public playlist; category 24 Entertainment → 29 Nonprofits & Activism; defaultLanguage unset → en; tags 11 → 17; added chapters.
  - Resolved the ambiguity in "proper caption" as three distinct YouTube fields that do not co-set: title prefix, description, and an SRT caption TRACK. With no voiceover, the SRT is written as bracketed per-beat scene descriptions — gives YouTube text to index and gives a deaf viewer what a hearing viewer gets from music and imagery, at zero visual cost since it is not burned in.
  
  5. Media lineage system — the anti-reuse half (the part that compounds)
  - Diagnosed that MAP (MEDIA_ARCHIVE_PIPELINE.md) already provides intake/dedupe/yt_id for RAW capture but has no vocabulary for the inverse edge: which raw clips a GENERATED video consumed. Without that edge the same establishing shot is silently re-cut into every film.
  - Created TrueSightDAO/generated-media-raw (public, blessed *-raw pattern), mirroring MAP field names so the anti-reuse query works alongside existing farm tooling, adding lineage[], clearance_flags[], reuse_guard.
  - Traced every beat of V9: 3 verified (S1_BARPHOTO.jpg confirmed by image similarity corr 0.918, not by guess; /media/cvp/IMG_7654.MOV @ 6.5 s from build_a4e.sh; endcard generated). 3 recorded honestly as unknown.
  - Established the honesty rule: an untraced beat is "unknown" PLUS the search method that failed. A blank field is indistinguishable from "nobody looked." A final sweep of all 12 raw MOVs returned 0.310 for two different beats against the same frame — recognised as noise, not provenance, and recorded as such.
  - Recorded the governor's decision to keep the farmer beat in a separate acceptance block with an explicit does_not_imply guard, so acceptance is never mistaken for provenance and the beat is not silently cleared for re-use.
  
  6. Documentation — agentic_ai_context PR #1827 (merged)
  MAP extended with the generated-artifact namespace, the per-beat lineage schema and honesty rule, the full YouTube indexing checklist, the three-kinds-of-caption disambiguation, the contested-query finding (bare "agroverse" competed by unrelated AgroVerse channels), the YouTube search.list staleness trap, and 6 new anti-patterns.
  
  CORRECTION LOGGED FOR THE RECORD
  Reported to the governor that V9 was "not indexed for 'agroverse'" — that was wrong. A general-term re-query returned rank #1. The cause was search.list staleness immediately after a metadata change. Documented as a trap so the next agent does not repeat it; the phantom failure was retracted rather than left standing.
  
  OUTCOME
  Two cut options plus a final master delivered, published publicly with provenance marked in three places (title prefix, description disclaimer, tags), lineage archived, conventions written into MAP so no future agent has to rediscover them.
  
  Cost: $0. No paid generation (Kling) used at any point.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 650.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
--------
